literal_meaning: ঘাড়ে দুটি মাথা থাকা (having two heads on the neck)
figurative_meaning_en: to be extremely daring or audacious
similar_in_english: to bite off more than one can chew
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার ঘাড়ে দুটো মাথা নেই যে এমন ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ কাজ করব।
সে ঘাড়ে দুটো মাথা থাকলে পুলিশের সামনে এভাবে কথা বলত না।
example_sentences_in_english: I don't have two heads on my neck to take such a risky job.
If he had two heads, he wouldn't speak like that in front of the police.
note: This idiom implies foolhardy bravery, often used to express reluctance to take unnecessary risks.
